market_base_token_supply.meaning: baseToken supply of the small market before the mint

mint_amount.meaning: amount the attacker attempts to mint via mintLogic

mint_amount_exceeds_market_supply.meaning: mintAmount > marketBaseTokenSupply holds for the attempted mint

protocol_insolvent.meaning: protocol reaches complete insolvency with synthetic tokens unbacked

assumptions: The 1,000-token market supply pre-exists the mintLogic call.
The mint cap check is the guard that should prevent mints beyond Q96 or marketBaseTokenSupply.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether the caller is authorized or permissionless; attacker role is inferred.

The intent's OR grouping (mintAmount > Q96 OR mintAmount > marketBaseTokenSupply) cannot be faithfully encoded as the condition of a single progress/liveness obligation without inventing the disjunctive guard semantics; the plan encodes the report-stated scenario where both bounds are exceeded.

limitations: Condition encodes the report's concrete scenario (mintAmount == Q96 and exceeds market supply) rather than the general OR-guard requirement.
protocol_insolvency is represented as a Boolean outcome because the report gives no numeric backing/liability definition.
Code-level binding of the mint cap check is deferred.
